questions.q_en: Nine seedlings on one plate is n = 1, not n = 9. What happens to your p below 0.0001?
questions.q_zh: 一盤九棵苗，那是 n = 1 不是 n = 9。你們那個 p < 0.0001 還剩下什麼？
kw_en: seedlings in a plate are pseudoreplicates
the trend survives, the p value does not
questions.a_en: You are right, and it is the single biggest weakness in our plant work: seedlings inside one plate share their medium, their salt and their position in the chamber, so the plate is the experimental unit and the p value computed across nine seedlings is an overstatement. What survives is the trend rather than the statistic — the salt ladder is monotone across four levels, 74.95, 34.77, 11.00 and 1.36 millimetres of root length at 0, 75, 100 and 150 millimolar, and a dose response that clean does not depend on the test. What does not survive is any single-plate comparison between a treated and an untreated condition, which is why the Results page says no protectant of ours has a validated rescue while the Plants page reports what we saw. The fix is on our future-work list and it is specific: at least three independent plates per condition, so an improvement is a property of the condition and not of one plate.
questions.a_zh: 你說得對，而這是我們植物實驗最大的單一弱點：同一盤裡的苗共用培養基、共用鹽、也共用在生長箱裡的位置，所以盤才是實驗單位，用九棵苗算出來的 p 值是誇大的。還站得住的是趨勢而不是統計量——鹽度梯度在四個濃度上是單調的，0、75、100、150 mM 對應的主根長是 74.95、34.77、11.00、1.36 毫米，這麼乾淨的劑量反應不依賴任何檢定。站不住的是任何「單一盤的處理組對未處理組」的比較，這也是為什麼 Results 頁寫「我們沒有任何保護蛋白有經驗證的 rescue」，而 Plants 頁只報我們看到的現象。補救方式在我們的 future work 上，而且很具體：每個條件至少三個獨立的盤，讓改善成為條件的性質，而不是某一盤的性質。
questions.trap_en: Defending the n. Concede the pseudoreplication first, then point at the monotone ladder as the result that does not need the test.
questions.trap_zh: 替 n 辯護。先承認偽重複，再指向那條單調的鹽度梯度——那是不需要檢定的結果。

questions.q_en: Your clearest rescues are trehalose at 8.7-fold and a commercial peptide. Neither is yours. Why should I believe your proteins do anything?
questions.q_zh: 你們最清楚的 rescue 是 8.7 倍的海藻糖和一個商業胜肽，兩個都不是你們做的。那我憑什麼相信你們的蛋白有用？
pages: plant#Testing the efficacy of commercial CH Bio peptide
kw_en: they prove the assay can see a rescue
kw_zh: 證明這套 assay 看得到 rescue
我們的是沒有重複的正向結果
questions.a_en: You should not believe it yet, and we say so on the Results page. Trehalose and the CH Biotech peptide are reference compounds, and their job in our work is to show the assay can detect a rescue at all — trehalose at 5 millimolar raised chlorophyll about 8.7-fold at 100 millimolar sodium chloride with a clean dose series behind it. Our own positives are real but thin: ACC deaminase pre-treatment held about seventy percent more chlorophyll at 100 millimolar, ACC deaminase post-treatment was fourteen percent above the heat control, and BoPep4 at one in forty kept hydroponic seedlings green under salt — each one plate or one pot per condition, with the best timing differing between trials. So the claim is that we built an assay that can see a rescue and have not yet run our own proteins through it with the replication a claim needs.
questions.a_zh: 你現在還不該相信，而我們在 Results 頁上就是這樣寫的。海藻糖和正瀚的胜肽是參考化合物，它們在我們的工作裡的任務是證明「這套 assay 偵測得到 rescue」——5 mM 海藻糖在 100 mM NaCl 下讓葉綠素提高大約 8.7 倍，而且背後有一條乾淨的劑量系列。我們自己的正向結果是真的，但很薄：ACC 去胺酶事前處理在 100 mM 下多保住大約七成葉綠素、ACC 去胺酶事後處理比熱逆境對照高 14%、BoPep4 1/40 讓水耕苗在鹽逆境下維持綠色——每一個都是一個條件一盤或一盆，而且最佳時機在不同 trial 之間還不一致。所以我們的主張是：我們做出了一套看得到 rescue 的 assay，但還沒有用一個主張所需要的重複數把自己的蛋白跑過一遍。
questions.trap_en: Inflating our own positives to match the reference compounds. The strength of this answer is the order: assay first, our results second, with their n stated.
questions.trap_zh: 把自己的正向結果吹到跟參考化合物一樣強。這題的力量在順序：先講 assay，再講我們的結果，並且把 n 講出來。

questions.q_en: Your hydroponic data show the host culture alone stresses the plants, and you voided the ACC deaminase salinity run because culture volume was not standardised. How do you know any rescue is the protein and not the medium?
questions.q_zh: 你們的水耕數據顯示光是宿主菌培養液就會讓植物有壓力，而且你們因為各組培養液體積沒有統一而把 ACC 去胺酶的鹽逆境實驗作廢。那你們怎麼知道 rescue 是蛋白而不是培養基？
kw_en: volume was not standardised, so one run is void
kw_zh: WB800 是無保護蛋白對照
體積沒統一，所以那次作廢
questions.a_en: The control is built for exactly that: every protectant arm is matched against WB800 culture carrying no protectant construct, at the same dilution, so a difference between those two is the protein and not the broth. That control is also what told us the vehicle itself stresses the plants, which is why everything is diluted at least sixteen-fold and one in forty became the working dose — in the salinity run at 100 millimolar the one in forty BoPep4 group stayed green with the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll while the one in forty WB800 group did not. Where the control was not enough is the run Dr. Peng voided: culture volume differed between arms, so the groups also differed in how much broth they received and a dilution series cannot be read as a dose. Our future work names the three things that fix it — a fixed interval for changing the medium, the same culture volume in every group, and evaporation accounted for instead of topped up.
questions.a_zh: 對照組就是為這件事設計的：每一個保護蛋白組都對上「不帶保護蛋白構築」的 WB800 培養液，而且稀釋倍數相同，所以這兩組之間的差異是蛋白、不是培養液。也正是這個對照告訴我們載體本身會讓植物有壓力，所以所有東西至少稀釋十六倍，1/40 成為工作劑量——在 100 mM 的鹽逆境實驗裡，1/40 的 BoPep4 組維持綠色、鮮重和葉綠素都最高，而 1/40 的 WB800 組沒有。對照不夠用的地方就是彭博士判定作廢的那次：各組培養液體積不同，所以組與組之間連「拿到多少培養液」都不一樣，稀釋系列就不能當劑量讀。我們的 future work 寫出了修正它的三件事——固定換液間隔、每組相同的培養液體積，以及把蒸發計入而不是直接補水。
questions.trap_en: Saying the control settles it. It settles the matched comparisons; it does not rescue the run where the volume varied, and that run is void.
questions.trap_zh: 說有對照組就解決了。對照組解決的是配對比較；它救不了體積不一致那一次，而那一次是作廢的。

questions.q_en: Everything you applied to a plant was 0.22 micrometre filtered crude supernatant with no activity number behind the batch. So what was the dose?
questions.q_zh: 你們施用到植物上的全部都是 0.22 微米過濾的粗上清，而且每一批背後都沒有活性數字。那劑量到底是多少？
kw_en: filtered crude supernatant, not purified enzyme
dose is a dilution and a volume
kw_zh: 過濾粗上清，不是純化酵素
劑量是稀釋倍數加體積
questions.a_en: The dose is a dilution and a volume, not an activity, and I want to be exact about the material: it was 0.22 micrometre filtered crude supernatant, so if any page of ours says the purified enzyme, that is a wording slip. What we can state is the geometry — three sprays delivered 1.67 millilitres onto a 78.5 square centimetre plate, which is the same rate as 2126 litres per hectare, and in hydroponics the arms are dilutions of one in forty to one in a hundred against a matched WB800 culture. The model turns that into 37.6 kilounits per hectare per application by multiplying the sprayed volume by one measured secreted activity, and it is the dose that worked rather than the smallest that works, because our sets varied salt level and timing but never the applied amount. No dilution series was ever run in soil, so there is no minimum effective dose, and that is the first experiment on the plant side.
questions.a_zh: 劑量是稀釋倍數加體積，不是活性，而我想把材料講精確：那是 0.22 微米過濾的粗上清，所以如果我們任何一頁寫「純化酵素」，那是用詞失誤。我們能講的是幾何——三次噴灑把 1.67 毫升施到 78.5 平方公分的盤上，相當於每公頃 2126 公升；水耕那邊各組是 1/40 到 1/100 的稀釋，對上相同稀釋的 WB800 培養液。模型把這個換成每公頃每次施用 37.6 kU，做法是噴灑體積乘上一個量到的分泌活性，而那是「有效的劑量」而不是「最小有效劑量」，因為我們的實驗組變動的是鹽度和時機，從來沒有變動施用量。土壤裡從來沒有做過稀釋系列，所以不存在最小有效劑量，那也是植物端的第一個實驗。
questions.trap_en: Quoting 37.6 kilounits per hectare as a measured dose. It is a volume multiplied by one activity reading; say so, and say the minimum effective dose does not exist yet.
questions.trap_zh: 把每公頃 37.6 kU 當成量到的劑量報出來。那是體積乘上一個活性讀值；要講清楚，並且說最小有效劑量目前還不存在。

questions.q_en: BoPep4 co-treatment harmed the plants even without salt, and your own page says the protectant brings harm when released without demand. Is that not an argument against a machine that produces continuously?
questions.q_zh: BoPep4 同時處理在沒有鹽的情況下也傷害植物，而你們頁面上自己寫「在沒有需求時釋放反而造成傷害」。這不正好是反對一台持續生產的機器嗎？
kw_en: it argues for the gate, not against it
kw_zh: 這是支持那道閘門，不是反對
questions.a_en: It is an argument for the gate rather than against it, and it is the strongest one we have from our own data. Every BoPep4 co-treated plate was chlorotic, and the unstressed co-treated plate sat below the mock control on both weight and chlorophyll, which is the growth-versus-tolerance trade-off appearing in our own plants: an elicitor peptide that switches a plant into defence costs it growth when there is nothing to defend against. That is precisely why the decision of when to produce sits in the field, in a forecast and a light, instead of being wired into a constitutive strain — a machine that produced continuously would be delivering this penalty all season. What it also means is that we owe a dose and timing window before any of this is deployable, and that window is the measurement, not the mechanism, that we are missing.
questions.a_zh: 這是支持那道閘門的論據，而不是反對它的，而且這是我們從自己數據裡拿到最強的一條。每一盤 BoPep4 同時處理的都出現黃化，而沒有加鹽的同時處理組在鮮重和葉綠素上都低於 mock 對照——這就是「生長 vs 耐受」的取捨出現在我們自己的植物上：一個把植物切進防禦狀態的 elicitor peptide，在沒有東西要防禦的時候會讓它付出生長的代價。這正是為什麼「什麼時候生產」這個決定放在田裡、放在預測和一盞燈上，而不是接進一株組成型的菌裡——一台持續生產的機器會整季都在交付這個代價。它同時也意味著：在任何部署之前我們還欠一個劑量與時機窗口，而我們缺的是那個量測，不是機制。
questions.trap_en: Treating this as a weakness to be minimised. It is the project's own evidence for why the light gate exists; lead with that and then concede the missing dose window.
questions.trap_zh: 把這題當成要淡化的弱點。它是這個專案自己拿出來、說明為什麼需要光閘門的證據；先講這個，再承認缺少劑量窗口。

questions.q_en: ACC deaminase post-treatment falls below the heat control in both soil trials, and your two agar heat trials disagree on which timing is best. What do you actually claim about timing?
questions.q_zh: ACC 去胺酶事後處理在兩次土壤試驗裡都低於熱逆境對照，而你們兩次 agar 熱逆境試驗對「哪個時機最好」的結論又相反。那你們對時機到底主張什麼？
pages: plant#Evaluating ACC deaminase rescue efficacy under prolonged 37
kw_en: timing decides the sign, not the size
efficacy is an axis in the model
kw_zh: 時機決定正負號，不是大小
兩次 trial 結論相反
模型把效力當成一個軸
questions.a_en: Only that timing decides the sign of the effect, not which timing is best. Our runs do not agree: on agar at 75 millimolar pre-treatment gave the highest fresh weight, 0.164 against 0.144 grams for co-treatment; in the agar heat set trial 1 favoured pre-treatment and trial 2 favoured post-treatment at plus fourteen percent chlorophyll; and in soil heat, post-treatment fell below the heat control in both trials. What is consistent across the whole programme is that co-treatment is the worst option and that applying a protectant with no stress present can hurt, which is a direction rather than a number. That is why the model treats efficacy as an axis instead of a fixed value, and why the experiment we owe is the three timings against a standardised salt load with three independent replicates each, so the timings can be compared on equal terms.
questions.a_zh: 我們只主張「時機決定效果的正負號」，不主張哪個時機最好。我們的實驗彼此不一致：agar 75 mM 下事前處理鮮重最高，0.164 對同時處理的 0.144 公克；agar 熱逆境 trial 1 偏向事前處理、trial 2 偏向事後處理（葉綠素高出 14%）；而土壤熱逆境裡，事後處理在兩次試驗都低於熱逆境對照。整個計畫裡一致的是「同時處理是最差的選項」以及「在沒有逆境時施用保護蛋白可能有害」，那是一個方向而不是一個數字。這也是為什麼模型把效力當成一個軸而不是固定值，以及為什麼我們欠的實驗是：在標準化鹽負荷下比較三個時機，每組三個獨立重複，讓時機能在同一條件下被比較。
questions.trap_en: Picking a best timing to sound decisive. The honest claim is the sign, plus naming the soil result that goes against us.
questions.trap_zh: 為了聽起來果斷而挑一個最佳時機。誠實的主張是正負號，再加上主動講出那個對我們不利的土壤結果。
